notes: MI 2025 vintage available on Justia. MCL is organized by named Acts grouped within numbered chapters (not numbered titles/chapters/sections). Chapter 4 (Legislature) houses the Lobbyists Registration Act, Act 472 of 1978 (MCL 4.411-4.431). Tree is 5 levels deep: state -> vintage -> chapter -> statute-act -> section. The act-472-of-1978 page exposes 23 section leaves; all are part of the Lobbyists Registration Act and included as core_chapter URLs. Section count (23) matches the 2015 ground-truth note in the dispatch brief. Justia URL convention uses 'statute-act-472-of-1978' (with 'statute-' prefix) as the slug, and section slugs use hyphenated form 'section-4-411' (corresponding to MCL 4.411). Chapter 169 (Campaign Financing and Advertising) intentionally excluded - separate regime. Act 214 of 1947 (legacy 'Legislative Agents') is marked Repealed and excluded.
